newsitem.title: THAILAND: OLYMPICS-ARMY CHIEF APPOINTED THAI OLYMPIC PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-ARMY CHIEF APPOINTED THAI OLYMPIC PRESIDENT.

text.p: The Thai Olympic Council on Friday named the nation's powerful army commander in chief, General Chetta Thanajaro, as its new president.
Chetta, the fifth president for the council, replaces the late Air Chief Marshal Thawee Chulatrap who led the council for more than two decades until his death in late 1995.
General Suraphol Banakitsophone temporarily held the post of president after Thawee died.
